description: Authenticated L2 inner-payload dispatch vectors. 'wrapped' is the link inner payload; byte 0 is the dispatch namespace and 'body' is the SCHC packet or routing/control message after that byte.

vectors.name: schc_global_coap
vectors.description: Authenticated L2 SCHC dispatch wrapping a SCHC global CoAP packet whose SCHC rule ID is 0x01.

vectors.name: routing_announce_min
vectors.description: Authenticated L2 routing dispatch wrapping a minimal raw announce whose routing message type is 0x01.

vectors.name: unknown_unwrapped_0x01
vectors.description: A payload beginning with 0x01 is not self-identifying at L2 and must not be treated as announce without dispatch=0x15.

vectors.name: malformed_schc_dispatch_only
vectors.description: A defined SCHC dispatch without its required rule ID body byte is malformed and must fail closed.

vectors.name: malformed_routing_dispatch_only
vectors.description: A defined routing dispatch without its required message type body byte is malformed and must fail closed.

vectors.name: sos_alert_dispatch
vectors.description: Authenticated L2 SOS dispatch (0x16) wrapping a §18.4.2 CBOR alert map fragment. SOS is NOT SCHC-compressed; relays classify solely by this byte (spec 02-physical-link.md §4.1, 12-apps.md §18.4.3). Distinct from the unrelated RPL DODAG Version option type 0x16 (different namespace).

vectors.name: malformed_sos_dispatch_only
vectors.description: A defined SOS dispatch without its required CBOR body byte is malformed and must fail closed.
